BrochureContent.Content:
No. 9 Ardmanagh Beg is a beautifully presented two-bedroom home situated in a small, well-maintained development on the edge of Schull village. Known for its family-friendly atmosphere, Ardmanagh Beg enjoys an attractive green area to the front and lovely views overlooking Schull village and harbour.
Immaculately presented throughout, this turnkey property offers bright and comfortable accommodation with a modern, well-appointed kitchen and stylish interiors that have been carefully maintained by its current owners. Sea views can also be enjoyed from both the ground and first floors. 
To the rear, is an enclosed garden complete with a decking area and a useful storage shed.
Conveniently located within walking distance of all attractions and amenities, this property combines the benefits of village living within a peaceful residential setting.
Ideal for those looking to downsize, retirees seeking a low-maintenance home, or buyers in search of that coveted holiday home within Schull. 

Note: This property is for sale with contents included. 

Features:
Electric Heating
Open fireplace in living room
Private rear garden, large communal green to the front. 
Ample parking spaces
Mains Services

Property layout: 
Entrance hall 
Living / dining / kitchen: (8m x 3.65m) Sea views 
Utility room & guest WC: (3.8m X 1.2m) 

1st Floor: 
Landing area
Bathroom: (1.9m x 2.5m) shower, wc, whb 
Bedroom 1: (4m x 2.5m) 
Bedroom 2: (3.6m x 3.5m) Sea views 

All information is provided in good faith and believed to be correct; however, it is not guaranteed and should be independently verified. No representations or warranties, express or implied, are made as to the accuracy, completeness, condition, or planning status of the property.
Interested parties should investigate independently as to the accuracy of all details, including measurements, boundaries, area, BER rating, and available services. In addition, all apparatus, fixtures, fittings or services should be thoroughly tested to assess their working condition.
Photographs and videos are for guidance purposes only and may show items (such as furniture) that are not included in the sale unless specifically agreed between the parties.
